at takes a Teaching_LinkHub run folder (the one with manifest.json/index.html/links/) and produces multiple ZIP batches sized for ChatGPT ingest.
Download
termux_teaching_linkhub_to_chatgpt_batches.sh

What it does (important)

Reads manifest.json (preferred) or paths.txt from your hub folder

Resolves those paths to the real files on disk

Copies them into staging folders

Creates ZIPs capped at 18 MiB each (default) for reliable ChatGPT uploads

Writes index.jso"
